text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, dammit!
I couldn't reach it...!
(WAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(...!
That's right, no, not yet—!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (—How about it? Today's the day...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Orfeee!
Lord Orfeee!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh.
Merely a glimpse of my supreme path."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The road is long—
stretching so far it fades from sight.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, my people.
Behold an even greater brilliance! The supreme path of conquest!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Oooohh!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Shioooon!!
That was totally sick!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
You did great!
You worked so hard!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you very much!
The stands took on a color unlike anything seen before.
Mingled with the loud cheers supporting Orfevre's brilliance were voices praising Win Variation for her hard-fought effort.

A shift occurs in the cheers that had been nearly unified until now,
and the roar reverberates across Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright.
Yes, yes, yes, yes, yeeesss...!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I made it, I made it this far!
I'm still far from being the star—but still!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
If I keep giving it my all like this,
I'll definitely be able to reach her...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To become something like that—the most beautiful,
most radiant existence... Me too, even I want to!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh, Trainer!
Um, there's a race I wanna enter!
The race proposed by the enthusiastic girl was—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm plannin' to run in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

The Japan Cup—
A Japanese GⅠ race where Umamusume from all over the world clash!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista, who's been dominating the Senior Year,
is also scheduled to run, right?
Could we get a word on your enthusiasm?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I might not even stand a chance,
but... well, I really want to try!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
We've made it this far, so
I started thinking that maybe we can go even further.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Crossing generations, crossing borders,
I want to race all kinds of strong Umamusume
and become stronger and stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: And so, if I can break out of my shell, I know I can definitely beat her!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see...! By the way, who do you mean by "that person"?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-ummm...!
choice_data_list: Anyway, look forward to what's to come!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Th-That's right!
Look forward to it!
Moved by Win Variation's passionate plea, I gladly agreed to enter the Japan Cup.

To overcome the formidable runners in the field,
the days of rigorous training have begun!
